<?php

require __DIR__.'/vendor/autoload.php';

$app = require_once __DIR__.'/bootstrap/app.php';
$kernel = $app->make(Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class);
$kernel->bootstrap();

$record = App\Models\CumulativeRecord::find(6);
$record->completed_steps = ['entry', 'personal', 'family', 'education', 'health', 'socio-economic', 'vocational', 'self', 'skills', 'social'];
$record->status = App\Enums\RecordStatus::Submitted;
$record->submitted_at = now();
$record->consent_given = true;
$record->consented_at = now();
$record->consent_name = 'Adrian G. Santiago';
$record->save();

$student = $record->student->loadMissing('program');
$staff = App\Models\User::query()->staffResponsibleFor($student->program?->college_id)->get();

Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification::send($staff, new App\Notifications\RecordSubmitted($record->setRelation('student', $student)));

echo "Notification sent successfully!\n";
